recipeCards.title: Pantry Shelf Setting Recipe
recipeCards.useCase: Adult-led paper recipe card for turning an ordinary table or shelf detail into a cozy story setting.
recipeCards.adultSetup: Print one card, place it on the table with a pencil, and ask the writer to choose one ordinary object to sketch.
recipeCards.kidDirection: Sketch the pretend pantry setting, name three story ingredients, and write one sentence that shows where the mystery begins.
recipeCards.recipeTitlePrompt: Recipe title: The pantry mystery setting is called ____________________.
recipeCards.storyIngredientsPrompt: Story ingredients: shelf shape ____________________, measuring mark ____________________, tiny clue ____________________.
recipeCards.mixItUpPrompt: Mix it up on paper by moving one clue from the shelf to ____________________.
recipeCards.servingSentencePath: Serving sentence: In the pantry map, ____________________ waits beside ____________________, so the mystery feels ready.
recipeCards.revisionNudge: Revise by adding one clear where-word to show the clue is near ____________________.
recipeCards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: sketch the shelf first, then label one place ____________________.
recipeCards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At another table, turn one ordinary object into a setting clue: ____________________.

recipeCards.title: Seed Drawer Object Recipe
recipeCards.useCase: Adult-led table card for making one paper object carry the main clue in a short map-room story.
recipeCards.adultSetup: Print one card, set out a pencil, and remind the writer that every seed drawer and label is pretend story language.
recipeCards.kidDirection: Choose a paper object, sketch its label, and imagine why the Seed Library Map Room needs that clue.
recipeCards.recipeTitlePrompt: Recipe title: The seed drawer object is named ____________________.
recipeCards.storyIngredientsPrompt: Story ingredients: drawer label ____________________, map mark ____________________, secret object ____________________.
recipeCards.mixItUpPrompt: Mix it up on paper by giving the object a new job: ____________________.
recipeCards.servingSentencePath: Serving sentence: The map keeper opens ____________________ and discovers ____________________ inside.
recipeCards.revisionNudge: Revise by adding one exact shape, color, or placement detail to ____________________.
recipeCards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: sketch the object first, then write its quiet label: ____________________.
recipeCards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At the table, turn one small paper shape into a map-room clue: ____________________.

recipeCards.title: Moss Message Sensory Recipe
recipeCards.useCase: Adult-led paper recipe card for collecting safe color, sound, and imagined texture details for a calm observatory scene.
recipeCards.adultSetup: Print one card, place it on the table with a pencil, and invite the writer to notice one color or pattern in the room.
recipeCards.kidDirection: Collect a color, a sound word, and an imagined texture, then turn them into a moss observatory message.
recipeCards.recipeTitlePrompt: Recipe title: The observatory message is called ____________________.
recipeCards.storyIngredientsPrompt: Story ingredients: color ____________________, soft sound ____________________, imagined texture ____________________.
recipeCards.mixItUpPrompt: Mix it up on paper by letting the message appear first on ____________________.
recipeCards.servingSentencePath: Serving sentence: The observer sees ____________________, hears ____________________, and imagines the message means ____________________.
recipeCards.revisionNudge: Revise by replacing one plain describing word with ____________________.
recipeCards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: point to one color silently, sketch it, and write ____________________.
recipeCards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use one safe room detail as the first observatory signal: ____________________.

recipeCards.title: Compass Route Sequence Recipe
recipeCards.useCase: Adult-led paper recipe card for older writers who want to arrange a scene into a clear three-step route.
recipeCards.adultSetup: Print one card, place it on the table with a pencil, and ask the writer to sketch a simple pretend route.
recipeCards.kidDirection: Choose a starting mark, a middle turn, and an ending place, then write the route as a story sequence.
recipeCards.recipeTitlePrompt: Recipe title: The compass route recipe is named ____________________.
recipeCards.storyIngredientsPrompt: Story ingredients: starting mark ____________________, middle turn ____________________, ending place ____________________.
recipeCards.mixItUpPrompt: Mix it up on paper by changing the middle turn toward ____________________.
recipeCards.servingSentencePath: Serving sentence: First ____________________, next ____________________, finally ____________________, so the map feels complete.
recipeCards.revisionNudge: Revise by adding one precise direction word or distance clue: ____________________.
recipeCards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: number the three route marks, then write only the strongest mark: ____________________.
recipeCards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use the route to begin a compass academy paragraph about ____________________.

recipeCards.title: Almost Invention Revision Recipe
recipeCards.useCase: Adult-led paper recipe card for revising a plain almost-invention idea into a clearer story moment.
recipeCards.adultSetup: Print one card, keep the work paper-only at the table, and invite the writer to sketch a nearly ready invention idea.
recipeCards.kidDirection: Write one plain almost-invention sentence, choose the unclear word, and revise it with a sharper story ingredient.
recipeCards.recipeTitlePrompt: Recipe title: The almost invention is called ____________________.
recipeCards.storyIngredientsPrompt: Story ingredients: plain idea ____________________, unclear word ____________________, sharper detail ____________________.
recipeCards.mixItUpPrompt: Mix it up on paper by moving the sharper detail closer to ____________________.
recipeCards.servingSentencePath: Serving sentence: Plain line: ____________________. Revised line: ____________________, because the detail shows ____________________.
recipeCards.revisionNudge: Revise by replacing one vague word with a precise noun or action: ____________________.
recipeCards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: underline one word silently, then write the clearer replacement: ____________________.
recipeCards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Keep the revised sentence as the first line of an almost-invention story: ____________________.
